subject: NUMVAL-C function
notes: The boundary is now measured ON NUMVAL-C, by a matched pair one digit apart in one run: a 31-digit currency-bearing argument-1 returns the represented value (the currency string is not a digit, 15.68.4 r2) and its 34-digit partner returns the 15.3 default 0. pb33 stays named for its reject line and for TEST-NUMVAL-C at the same boundary, which guards the validator/producer asymmetry that opened the row - but pb33's 31-digit control is on NUMVAL, not NUMVAL-C, so it could not close this row alone. || editions 2002,2014,2023 (kb/Work PB3173, S0b; DESIGN-conformance-suite.md §6 step 0): the 31-digit limit is stated for native arithmetic, the mode the ARITHMETIC clause (2002) names; the rule's form is the 2002 one. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Runtime/Intrinsics/CobolIntrinsics.Exact.cs#NumvalC (NumvalC was replaced by NumvalCDec and NumvalCLocaleDec when NUMVAL-C moved onto the SDIDI carrier (kb/Work PB251, 823e954c8))
